add_salt.title: Add salt tablets
add_salt.followup_prompt: How many bags of salt did you add? {user_name} is answering...
add_salt.complete: Added {bags} bags of salt. Next task: {next_due} Salt stock: {stock} bags

low_salt_stock.title: Order salt tablets — stock is low
low_salt_stock.alert: Salt stock is low! Currently: {bags} bags Order new stock and confirm how many bags arrived.
low_salt_stock.followup_prompt: How many bags did you order? {user_name} is answering...

start.description: Start the bot and show commands
start.message:
Bot is active!

Commands:
  /done — mark a task as completed
  /done bags=3 — add salt (3 bags)
  /status — show status of all tasks
  /remind — send reminder now (admin only)
  /stanje — show stock status

status.description: Show status of all tasks and stock
